title: Meal plans
description: Meal plans: recipes and free texts on days of a week or on the tray, shared like lists, put on a shopping list and kept in step with it, the staples a plan's people always have, a Server-Sent Events stream of each plan's changes, and the calendar feed. A session, or an API token with plan:read to read and plan:write to change (putting a plan on a list also needs lists:write); the calendar feed's secret is managed with a session only.
